resources.string: Saved on this phone · cloud transfer off
Points, photos and tracks stay on this phone. This beta does not create a cloud backup.
Copies sent by an earlier version may still exist on the server. This beta does not read, change or delete those copies.
Sign-in manages your profile only. It does not upload, restore or transfer points, photos or tracks.
Cloud transfer is off in this local beta. Your records and any pending transfer intentions remain on this phone.
